output.reason: [ev-6a9bf00a9956] is just a commit title saying #21065 ("add a check for user defined role referential integrity") was reverted. It does not say whether that check ever shipped in an earlier release. If it did not, this release has no net change and "removed" would be wrong. The text also does not say what the check validated or which configuration it covered, and protocol-behavior (wire behaviour) is a doubtful family for an RBAC validation check. To decide subject and change, we need the release that first shipped #21065, if any, and a description of what the check enforced.
